caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular piece of fabric, possibly a scarf or shawl, draped to form a gentle fold. The majority of the fabric is a consistent solid red color. At both visible ends, there are decorative borders: the left end features intricate, multicolored embroidery with floral and geometric patterns in shades of blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, and red, with blue and orange fringes at the edge. The right end shows a simpler border that is mainly orange with embroidered floral designs in pink, green, and black, and has a red and orange fringe. The background is plain and unembellished, a uniform light beige color that highlights the object. There is a small inscription or marking in white near the lower left part of the red area.
title: Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
